title: THE STOCK MARKET BUBBLE IS FINALLY POPPING
body_html:
Every week, I am browsing around. Seeing what the news is wrongfully chirping. What the most talked about topics are in the stock market. Which stocks are sucking retail investors in and insiders are screwing over. Which influencer said the most financially incorrect thing on the internet. Point being, I am always staying up to date with what the trend is. When it comes to public commentary, the “trend” is often wrong.

I was curious, what were the most viral posts on Substack this week. Market Watch1 monitors this kind of activity. Here were some of the most viral post titles:

  • THE REVOLUTION IS REAL. SO IS THE BUBBLE.

  • THE WORLD IS BURNING THROUGH ITS EMERGENCY OIL. (THE ENERGY CRISIS IS ON BORROWED TIME)….

  • Don’t Believe Your Lyin’ Eyes, GPU Depreciation & Useful Lives

  • “DOWNFALL.” U.S. JOBS MARKET COLLAPSES…

After reading these headlines, I glanced over at the S&P 500 Futures: .1% away from all time highs. In fact, despite a small pullback since the 13th of August, we have been trending upwards since the 16th of August. Most stocks, have been having a pretty splendid few weeks.

One thing before we get into the market…

I’m working on this week’s Mid Week Movers right now, where I rank the stocks you’ve asked about from worst to first.

In the September 23rd edition, the #1 and #2 stocks are both still in my buy territory.

So far in 2026, stocks that have finished #1 in Mid Week Movers are averaging a 25.9% return.

→ See the September 23rd Mid Week Movers (click here)

Now, do not get me wrong… if you think I am oblivious to the barrage of negative economic data (debt, inflation, jobs), the turbulent geopolitical situation (Iran, China, Russia, Venezuela, etc.) or policy decisions that will have long standing impacts on the average American’s life (tariffs, Fed spending cuts, financial frameworks for things like stable coins and crypto)…respectfully, you are mistaken.

The market, the economy and portfolios, will pay for this assortment of “badness” listed above, in the form of a market meltdown. We have discussed the meltdown ever since I called the meltup, a strong bull market under poor economic conditions, in 2022. A meltup is followed by a blow off top (in which there is strong evidence we have been in the blow off top phase since June 2025), and then a meltdown. I have not called the meltdown yet.

But why does this matter? Because here’s what happens every time investors see one of these terrifying headlines:

  1. Read the headline.

  2. Shit their pants.

  3. Panic

  4. Hit “SELL”

  5. Watch the market recover without them.

  6. Declare the stock market rigged.

And then, a few months later, they do it all over again.

I’ve watched this cycle repeat over and over since 2023. Fear gets clicks. Fear gets shared. And fear gets investors to make some incredibly stupid decisions.

Subscribe now

On 22 September, news came out from TrendSpider on X, that Michael Burry had disclosed his updated positions. When I reviewed them… I scratched my head thinking “How in the F is he fighting every single trend?!” Literally. I could understand 1 or 2 contrarian takes…. but everything was wrong. All of them. Fast forward to today:

  • 7 of the 9 positions would have put investors into a loss.

  • 2 are breakeven

  • 1 is up, Birkenstock at +4.8%. Wow 🙄

You may have noticed my title… pretty inflammatory headline right?

That was intentional. I gave you the same kind of headline I showed you above. I do believe we’re in a bubble. But bubbles can get much, much bigger. And markets can remain irrational far longer than people expect.

Relax. The bubble isn’t bursting, at least not yet. I just gave you the same headline the internet has been using to scare you.

Despite a huge bear, slumbering inside of me, we do not fight trends here. Trend is up. The very best indicator or signal of an imminent market crash, is price action itself. Not some headline. Not some Tradingview indicator (including mine). Not some speculation on a financial report. Its PRICE ACTION.

We will see some reputable large cap stock collapse, significantly, in a single day. The stock market heat map will be a sea of red. Headlines will once again, be wrong, and say “this is the deal of a lifetime!”

But this has not been the case in months. Its not the case today. Stocks are making highs, not lows.

Why so many people follow, and even pay, for these misleading posts, is beyond my understanding.

Ignore the news. Ignore these inflammatory headlines. They are designed for clicks and views… not to help your portfolio.

Now… for those that actually want to make some money…

Lets review some of these stocks and see where some opportunities are at…

Burry and I actually agree on a lot. Where we differ, is I do not fight trends. Its clear we both share a lack of trust on Nvidia “fundamentals”... a stock I have largely deemed “avoid” since 2024; and since that point, price action has done nothing of note. As he mentions below (assuming Burry is actually behind Cassandra Unchained… something I have questioned and received no confirmation to) Nvidia is consistently “promoting itself.”

I noted in 2024 that Jensen would say anything, in an effort to pump his stock. You literally saw Jensen Huang get a phone call from President Trump on September 14th, dismissing AI concerns as a ‘hoax’.2 What a flamboyant case of showmanship 🙄. The investors presentation consistently appears like something a 6th grade student in a power point class would put together. This actually makes sense, considering that more than half of Americans have below a 6th grade reading level comprehension.3

Going further, November 15th, I posted that Nvidia matches Enron in many forms. Still does today. Then on the 23rd of November, Nvidia investor relations said their accounting was not comparable to Enron’s and ‘checked’ Burry’s criticisms. Essentially a feud began between Nvidia and Burry soon after.

I can never prove this, but I have always speculated my initial comparison to Enron was taken and used without consent. This would not be the first time my analysis is picked up by mainstream talking heads. But I digress.

My stance on Nvidia, fundamentally, remains that it is a 🚽. This is clearly a bubble. However, as a trend investor, and as much as I despise , trend is up. In fact, Nvidia’s chart has built a Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP), the structure Mark Minervini, 2-Time U.S. Investing champion uses. Higher lows, declining volume, accumulation buy days, and a break out to all time highs.

You do not short all time highs. As much disdain that I have for this stock, which in the long run, it is my belief it will be a predominant variable in the meltdown, there has not been a decent justification to short this stock since November 2025 (which we tried, took a profit, but was stopped out eventually.)

Nvidia looks bullish… at least for now.

Do I think it will go up forever? Absolutely not. Where is the top? No idea… I can’t time tops, especially in the future. We look for weakness as a signal to get out. Remember, price action is king. But for now, I think Nvidia is going to go up and that a healthy profit can be made. I also think it is going to cause bears some intense, short to mid-term pain.

I wish you could see how much I am rolling my eyes as I type that. 🙄

Subscribe now

Oh…. Palantir…

Palantir was one of my best calls from 2024, rising more than 600%.

This is another stock, that is showing nothing but strength. Do I think it will do another 600%? Probably not. Very unlikely in fact. But zooming in to see the price action locally, we have an asset that is gapping up. An accumulation signal on 04 August, higher lows, higher highs. There is yet again, no reason to be shorting this stock. Especially with price action above the 200 day moving average (a hard rule of mine, is to not short any stocks above the 200 DMA).

I do not like giving price targets… we take what the market gives us. But my speculative, take with a grain of salt, guess, on where Palantir, is going to go, is that it will break above the $200 barrier and make a run for $300. Again… do not get married to those targets. But that seems to be the reasonable target range and scenario, for now. Focus on getting into profit first… guessing tops 2nd. Your stop will protect your profits before your speculation of a top will.

Personally, stocks like Nvidia and Palantir no longer interest me, even though I think they are going to do well in the short to mid term time frame. Even though I think they are going to do well in the short term, I think they will quickly become crowded trades, due to their popularity with retail investors. I see on social media, young investors, buying Palantir at $200 a share, and clamoring that they are early LOL.

If you would like to see My current positions and where I stand with them, click here.

I have ranted enough today. If you have questions, feel free to swing by the Main Chat, and we can talk more about this article or any other thoughts you may have. We have a great community of down to earth investors and traders. We respect each other, even in moments we may disagree on something.

Be sure to like ❤️ and re-stack 🔄 this post! It helps combat the AI SLOP.
